summary.intent: Decide whether Phase 72 needed discussion before planning, reconcile drift between shipped Phase 70/70.1/71 todos and the pending backlog, assess parallelism between Phases 72/73, then kick off Phase 72 planning — which got interrupted by two CI regressions (desktop-e2e and web-e2e) that needed diagnosis and fixing first.
summary.outcome: Retired 8 stale Phase 71 todos to completed/, added zeroize and 68.2-coderabbit todos to Phase 72/73 source lists (uncommitted, to ride the Phase 72 planning commit), confirmed 72→73 must be sequential due to shared client.ts churn, then paused Phase 72 planning to ship two regression fixes: PR #600 (web-e2e IndexedDB floor-store helper, test-only) and PR #601 (Rust fuse seq-equivocation fix in content_ops.rs). Phase 72 planning work is stashed pending both merges; #600 also needed a CodeRabbit comment-accuracy fix and a sdk-e2e re-run after an unrelated flake.

repo: This repo retires todos by deleting/moving them from pending/ to completed/, not by editing status fields — Phase 71 shipped (#599) without doing this, leaving 8 stale-but-done todos in pending/ that had to be manually reconciled

Phase 70.1 collapsed two IndexedDB stores (generation-high-water + seq-high-water) into one rotation-floor store (DB v2, keyed by nodeId, value {generation?, seq?, wrappedKeyCheckpoint?}) — old store names are gone; anything still probing them silently returns undefined instead of erroring

sdk-e2e Test 21 (D-06 concurrent first-publish) is a known flake: it asserts exactly one 409 but Phase 71's same-CID idempotency makes both requests potentially return 200, so failures there are often unrelated to the PR under test
web-e2e only runs on main-push, not on PRs — merging a web-e2e fix is validated by typecheck/production-schema review only; true runtime proof lands post-merge

Phase 72 and Phase 73 both modify packages/sdk/src/client.ts heavily (getWriteBodyParams, write-plane helpers, buildSharedWriteContextFromState/publishNodeFn) — real file-level coupling, not just conservative roadmap ordering, so they can't be worked in parallel except for 73's pure apps/web SCs (#1/#2/#5)

code.finding: publish_file_node hardcoded seq=1 on the first-publish branch gated only by 'inode cid empty'; a dropped/stale UploadComplete replay re-triggers this branch with a fresh CID at seq=1, colliding with Phase 71's IPNS anti-equivocation gate. Fix: resolve IPNS name first (mirroring resolve_ipns_for_replay in publish.rs:39 / replay.rs:324 idiom) and route Found (already-published) cases into the existing CAS-bump publish_with_cas_retry path instead of skipping or re-sealing at seq=1.

D-05 hard-guard: same-sequence republish with a different CID throws BadRequestException (anti-equivocation); same-CID idempotent re-sign still succeeds. This is the gate the FUSE seq=1 bug collided with.

Test helper probed the old pre-v2 IndexedDB store names (generation-high-water/seq-high-water) instead of the current rotation-floor store, so it always returned floors.generation === undefined — a stale test, not a product durability bug; product write path was intact.

workflow: When two long-running verification/classification subagents are in flight, wait for their task-notifications instead of polling — avoids wasted turns

Before applying a subagent's proposed patch to shipped/production code, independently verify it against the real schema/source (e.g. read the actual IndexedDB schema, actual Rust function signatures) rather than trusting the agent's diagnosis blindly
When CI regressions interrupt planned work, stash the in-progress (intentionally uncommitted) work before switching to main to build fix branches, so it can be restored cleanly afterward

Root-cause investigation and patch application were split into separate agent calls (read-only diagnosis agent first, then manual verification + edit) to avoid blindly trusting agent-authored patches on Rust/production code

friction: User's first CI link (run #28941806263) turned out to be a one-off Web3Auth login flake, not the persistent web-e2e regression — required a second agent pass to find the real persistent cause (#598, Phase 70.1)

PR #600 (web-e2e test-only fix) had an unrelated sdk-e2e failure and a CodeRabbit nit requiring a second commit/push cycle to resolve, adding an extra round-trip before the fix could be considered done

cargo fmt showed diffs in file_handle.rs that were initially concerning but turned out to be a local rustfmt-version artifact unrelated to the actual edit, requiring extra verification steps to rule out
open_items: PR #601 (fuse seq-equivocation fix) still awaiting CI/desktop-e2e completion — being monitored in background
PR #600 needs a fresh commit push (comment fix) to re-trigger the flaked sdk-e2e check before it can merge
Phase 72 planning is paused mid-CONTEXT.md-authoring, stashed (stash@{0}) on the feat/phase-72 branch — resume once both #600 and #601 merge
68.2-coderabbit-hardening-backlog item 9 (shared-nav seed race) and other non-web items in that bundle remain unscoped/deferred — only items 4 and 9's web-relevant portions were folded into Phase 73
zeroize-file-keys-on-unwrap-error-path was added to Phase 72 as an opportunistic same-file batch, not a hard scope requirement — planner should decide whether to fold it into a formal SC

Defense-in-depth on IPNS rootNodeId/node pair-consistency (originally part of share-invite-validate-root-ownership, deliberately dropped per D-02) remains a potential future net-new scope item, not a regression
